description: Implementation of QuicHttpStream class handling QUIC HTTP streams, including request/response processing, stream initialization, error handling, and logging within Chromium's network stack.

classes.name: QuicHttpStream
classes.description: Handles QUIC HTTP stream operations including request/response lifecycle, error handling, and logging within Chromium's network stack.

methods.name: ConnectionInfoFromQuicVersion
methods.description: Returns connection info enum based on QUIC version.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info for the stream.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the QUIC stream with parameters like early send, priority, and logging.

methods.name: DoHandlePromise
methods.description: Handles promise (push) rendezvous.

methods.name: DoHandlePromiseComplete
methods.description: Completes promise handling, adopts push stream if successful.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over QUIC, manages headers, body, and response info.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads response body asynchronously.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, resets the stream.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if response body reading is complete.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Determines if the connection was reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Provides load timing metrics.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Returns alternative service info (QUIC).

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates detailed network error info.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets request priority.

methods.name: OnReadResponseHeadersComplete
methods.description: Callback for completion of response headers read.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases for the stream.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Returns Accept-CH via ALPS if available.

methods.name: GetQuicErrorCode
methods.description: Returns current QUIC connection error code.

methods.name: GetQuicRstStreamErrorCode
methods.description: Returns QUIC RST stream error code.

methods.name: ReadTrailingHeaders
methods.description: Reads trailing headers after response body.

methods.name: OnReadTrailingHeadersComplete
methods.description: Callback for trailing headers read completion.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles I/O completion and continues the state machine.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Invokes the user callback with the result.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main state machine loop for stream operations.

methods.name: DoRequestStream
methods.description: Requests a new stream from the session.

methods.name: DoRequestStreamComplete
methods.description: Completes stream request, handles stream adoption.

methods.name: DoSetRequestPriority
methods.description: Sets priority on the stream.

methods.name: DoSendHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers.

methods.name: DoSendHeadersComplete
methods.description: Completes header sending.

methods.name: DoReadRequestBody
methods.description: Reads request body data.

methods.name: DoReadRequestBodyComplete
methods.description: Completes request body read.

methods.name: DoSendBody
methods.description: Sends request body data.

methods.name: DoSendBodyComplete
methods.description: Completes request body sending.

methods.name: ProcessResponseHeaders
methods.description: Processes received response headers.

methods.name: HandleReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of read operations.

methods.name: ResetStream
methods.description: Resets and cleans up the stream.

methods.name: MapStreamError
methods.description: Maps stream errors to network error codes.

methods.name: GetResponseStatus
methods.description: Returns the current response status.

methods.name: SaveResponseStatus
methods.description: Saves the current response status.

methods.name: SetResponseStatus
methods.description: Sets the response status code.

methods.name: ComputeResponseStatus
methods.description: Computes the response status based on stream state and errors.

methods.name: SetRequestIdempotency
methods.description: Sets the idempotency of the request.
